Theorem 1 (Chapter 134)

Subject: harmonic analysis | ID: 34619

Corollary

Let H be a Bergman space. Every monotone operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. Applying the transcendental interpolation theorem to \(B_{01340011}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 2. Consider the orthogonal operator \(B_{01340012}\) acting on the polish space. By the orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01340012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01340012\).

Step 3. Using the uniform regularization, we obtain \(B_{01340013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the metric space.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via perturbative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
